document.about: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, January 2024, set in two columns: a page's text ends in its right column and goes on at the head of the next page's left one.

notes: 2026-11-28: a paragraph the page break cut read as two, one on each page. A paragraph at the foot of a page's last column, ending mid-sentence, goes on in the next page's first: the later part carries on the earlier (`doc:continues`), and the writers read them as one.

checks.issue: `…and the quits rate edged` / `down; both rates were below their levels` read as two paragraphs across pages 4 and 5.

continues.paragraph: down; both rates were below their levels at the start of 2023

checks.issue: `…short-term yields in most AFEs,` / `while longer-term foreign yields were little changed` read as two paragraphs.

continues.paragraph: while longer-term foreign yields were little changed
